What I ate at the Toronto Korean Festival 😋🇰🇷🇨🇦
The Rosé Topokki from @sinjeon_canada was the best!!

Now I get why they’re so popular in Korea!! The sauce was super, rich creamy, with just the right hint of spiciness.

I also love their kimbap as well!! 

The festival booth might be gone, but the good news is they have actual spot locations across the GTA! I’m definitely adding them to my regular food rotation whenever the craving hits. 💕

Tag your favorite foodie bestie so you can plan your next Topikki date, maybe I’ll bump into you there too! 😉
